text:
Maya (marketing): Need a tight benchmark narrative + 2 visuals for the launch assets. Audience: infra leads & PMs.
Ravi (data): Two visuals make sense: (1) latency vs $/1k tokens scatter with P50/P95/P99 callouts, (2) a tiny routing decision tree.
Jo (design): Keep charts clean: x=latency (ms), y=cost ($/1k). Two clusters: quantized throughput vs unquantized quality. Use SLA color bands.
Lena (prod): Headline idea: "Latency where it matters. Cost where it doesn't." One-line webinar CTA below charts.
Maya (marketing): Copy constraints: 12 words max per chart headline, 2 bullets per slide, 1 token-cost example annotation.
Ravi (data): Running microbench slices: chat-short (64), long (1024). BenchBot queued job 90123. Will post CSV when ready.
BenchBot: job 90123 complete 9 results: https://internal/bench/90123.csv
Ravi (data): Quick summary: chat-short P95 ~95ms, cost $0.09/1k. long quantized P95 ~310ms, cost $0.045/1k. long unquant P95 ~760ms, cost $0.12/1k.
Jo (design): Great. I'll make two PNGs: cluster view and workload-split view. Will include alt text and a 1-line legend for quantization.
Lena (prod): Webinar format: 20m demo + 10m Q&A. Title suggestion: "Serving LLMs: tuning latency and dollars".
Maya (marketing): Final checklist: 2 PNGs + alt text, chart headlines + bullets, token example (label as example), webinar CTA. Target: EOD.
Jo (design): On it 6 will drop files here when ready.
Ravi (data): Happy to sanity-check visuals.
Maya (marketing): Thanks team. We'll fast follow copy edits tomorrow morning if needed.
